lines.cap: Death walked into a wedding. He wasn't there for anyone. He just heard there was food.
lines.say: Death walked into a wedding. He wasn't there for anyone. He just heard there was food.

lines.cap: Six hours! My legs are magic! Nobody can stop me!
lines.say: Six hours! My legs are magic! Nobody can stop me!

lines.cap: Someone stop this uncle. Please. Anyone.
lines.say: Someone stop this uncle. Please. Anyone.

lines.cap: Then Death walks in. The music keeps playing. The uncle turns.
lines.say: Then Death walks in. The music keeps playing. The uncle turns.

lines.cap: Oh. Oh no. Is it. Is it my time?
lines.say: Oh. Oh no. Is it. Is it my time?

lines.cap: No. Relax. I'm here for the paneer.
lines.say: No. Relax. I'm here for the paneer.
lines.bubble: NO. I'M HERE FOR THE PANEER. 💀

lines.cap: The uncle sits down. For the first time in six hours. Everyone cheers.
lines.say: The uncle sits down. For the first time in six hours. Everyone cheers.

lines.cap: You did it. You stopped him. Stay for dinner.
lines.say: You did it. You stopped him. Stay for dinner.
lines.bubble: YOU STOPPED HIM. STAY FOR DINNER. 🤝

lines.cap: Finally. A wedding where I'm the fun one.
lines.say: Finally. A wedding where I'm the fun one.

lines.cap: Tag the uncle who never stops dancing. Only Death could stop him.
lines.say: Tag the uncle who never stops dancing. Only Death could stop him.
